analysis.title: Global Reflections (Louis Miller, 20 Nov 2026)
key_insights: The desk says the 4Q'18 analog narrative, which started about 6 weeks ago, has gone mainstream. It sees High Beta Cyclicals (GSXUHBCY) as a possible short if growth downgrades follow.

High Beta Cyclicals are up +12% YTD while broad US AI (GSTMTAIP) is negative on the year. The desk attributes the resilience to high growth optimism and to a market that has rotated out of AI into ex-AI rather than owning outright equity downside.
In 4Q-2018 High Beta Cyclicals fell -23% and underperformed SPX by 10pp. At 15x forward PE the basket trades at a 40% premium to its 2018 trough multiple.
The Lending Sensitive basket (GSXULEND) is flat QTD against a -15% decline in 4Q2018. It remains exposed to more Fed hawkishness and tighter lending conditions.
The preferred long is the High versus Low FCF pair (GSPUFCFP), flagged in last week's note, in the US and in Europe (GSPEFCFP).

European consumer baskets look stretched relative to 2018. UK Consumption (GSXEUKCO) and EU Domestic Consumption (GSXEDCON) are both up 12% QTD on resilient retail sales, but delivered -28% and -16% in 4Q18 and would be vulnerable to a growth shock.
The desk promotes its Conditional Downvar Strategy (GSISCVS1) as tail protection. Its flows show less than 5% of basket flows today were buy to open, so little offense is being played.

Construction of the Conditional Downvar: a variance swap replicated in a corridor (<15 delta) on SPX with a strip of 2M OTM puts in a 25% wide corridor, financed by narrow put spreads around the corridor barrier (15 delta), delta-hedged daily.

After today's 3.7% down move the spot is inside the protection corridor, about 2.5% above the barrier as of this morning. A further selloff next week gives a convex payoff. A reversal would take it out of the corridor, as in 2018, and could lock in losses on the delta hedge.

The Conditional Downvar does well in sudden, deep selloffs (2008, 2020) and poorly in slow or shallow selloffs with low realized vol (2022). Negative gamma peaks around the put spread strikes at the top of the corridor, so the worst case is a disorderly selloff that stops short of the barrier.

The desk prefers Healthcare over Staples. It launches the 2027 Top US healthcare themes basket (GSCBHC27), covering ACA beneficiaries, commercial biotech, drug discovery datasets, bioprocessing and tools, which it says have low macro correlation with oil, rates and AI.
The healthcare basket has had strong upward earnings revisions through 2028E, which would compress its multiple from 28x this year's earnings to as low as 19x on 2028 earnings.

China High Dividends (GSXACHHN) is up +3.4% since flagged last week while most China baskets ended the week lower. The desk still likes it as defensive exposure given policy support and a pick-up in National Team activity.

The desk stays bearish on China Competition (GSXECHNX) and recommends fading headline relief rallies, including the Dutch court ruling banning BYD Ti7 SUV sales in the EU, which BYD is expected to appeal. The basket is cheap at 11x forward PE, but that relies on consensus earnings where the desk sees structural downside risk, and valuation is at the 95th percentile of its 5-year history.

Fast money is light and slow money is full. CTAs, vol control and hedge fund net exposure are near the low end of their ranges, while real money positioning is not low and real money has continued to delever.
Beta adjusted nets are at 5-year lows. Fundamental L/S leverage fell 9 pts this week and more than 22 pts since early October to 48.2%, a 5-year low.

Offsetting the low net exposure are US equity ETF inflows, record-low mutual fund cash and heavy prime brokerage gross leverage, because books are running gross while keeping net low. Growth mutual fund manager beta is at the 90th percentile of its history.

tension_points.bull_case: Growth optimism has remained high and the market has rotated out of AI into ex-AI rather than owning outright equity downside, leaving High Beta Cyclicals up +12% YTD.
tension_points.bear_case: In 4Q-2018 the basket fell -23% and underperformed SPX by 10pp. It now trades at 15x forward PE, a 40% premium to its 2018 trough, and the Lending Sensitive basket is exposed to Fed hawkishness.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Growth uncertainty failing to take over from inflation anxiety, so that growth downgrades do not ensue. The report states this as the condition for the analog to play out.

tension_points.bull_case: If the selloff accelerates next week, the long puts kick in and the desk expects a convex payoff. The strategy does well in sudden, deep selloffs such as 2008 and 2020.
tension_points.bear_case: Slow or shallow selloffs with low realized vol are challenging (2022). Peak negative gamma at the top of the corridor makes a disorderly selloff that stops short of the barrier the worst case.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A reversal next week that takes spot out of the corridor, which is how 2018 played out and could lock in losses on the delta hedge.

tension_points.bull_case: Significant relative underperformance, depressed valuations, subdued earnings expectations, potential for a short squeeze and a European protectionist narrative.
tension_points.bear_case: The 11x forward PE relies on consensus earnings where the desk sees structural downside risks, and valuation is at the 95th percentile of its 5-year history.
